en.title: MossImage: independent hosted image studio
en.summary: MossImage is an independent browser-based image studio with MOSS-Image generation, JSON layout controls and other image models. Its published plans use credits; exact account access and current availability were not tested.
en.detail:
MossImage at mossimage.run is a hosted creative studio operated by Moxion Labs LLC according to its Terms of Use. It is not affiliated with OpenMOSS or fal.ai. The separate OpenMOSS MOSS-Image project is an open-weight model family; this listing describes the studio product, not that repository or model as a duplicate tool. The studio says it runs MOSS-Image-SFT through fal.ai and offers other providers' image models and editing workflows. Its home page describes text-to-image generation, English and Chinese lettering, JSON layout control and prompt-led creation. These are vendor-described capabilities; we did not test model quality, editing fidelity, provider routing, service availability or outputs. Do not infer that the MOSS-Image model edits photos: the site distinguishes its hosted editing models from MOSS-Image generation.

The public pricing page lists three starter images, a one-time pack of 30 images for USD 9.99, a monthly plan at USD 14.99 for 80 images, and an annual plan at USD 119 for 800 images. It says taxes may apply and monthly credits may roll over once, subject to a stated cap. Prices and plan terms can change; checkout, region, account eligibility and actual credit use were not tested.

The privacy page says prompts and settings are sent to fal.ai and generated files are hosted by that provider; the studio keeps short-lived result links rather than a permanent image library. Stripe processes checkout and billing, while the studio retains account, quota, purchase and operational records. Provider retention practices and deletion timing are not established by the studio policy. Avoid sensitive uploads unless the applicable provider terms meet your requirements.

Best for creators who want a browser workflow combining text-to-image, layout guidance and access to several hosted models. Not ideal for teams requiring self-hosted inference, guaranteed output fidelity, provider-independent retention or account-specific cost guarantees. Compare with OpenMOSS MOSS-Image for self-hosted/open-weight control, and with hosted image studios on editing workflow, model choice, credit costs and data routing. The existing OpenMOSS model listing remains a separate entity; no Task Fit or Task Page is created by this selection.

cn.title: MossImage：独立托管式图像创作工作室
cn.summary: MossImage 是独立的浏览器图像工作室，提供 MOSS-Image 生成、JSON 布局控制和其他图像模型。公开方案按 credits 计费；本站未测试账户权益或当前可用性。
cn.detail:
MossImage 位于 mossimage.run。其服务条款称运营方为 Moxion Labs LLC，并说明它与 OpenMOSS、fal.ai 均无关联。OpenMOSS 的 MOSS-Image 是独立开放权重模型系列；本条目描述的是工作室产品，不是该模型或仓库的重复工具。该工作室称通过 fal.ai 运行 MOSS-Image-SFT，并提供其他供应商的图像模型和编辑流程。官网介绍文生图、中英文文字、JSON 布局控制及提示词创作。这些是厂商描述；本站未测试模型质量、编辑保真度、供应商路由、服务可用性或生成结果。不要推断 MOSS-Image 模型能编辑照片：官网区分了托管编辑模型与 MOSS-Image 生成。

公开价格页列出 3 张入门图片、一次性 30 张图片包（USD 9.99）、每月 80 张（USD 14.99）和每年 800 张（USD 119）。页面称可能另加税，月度 credits 可按说明结转一次并受上限约束。价格和方案可能变化；本站未测试结账、地区、账户资格或实际 credits 消耗。

隐私页称提示词和设置会发送至 fal.ai 处理，生成文件由该供应商托管；工作室保留短期结果链接，而非永久图库。Stripe 处理结账和账单，工作室另保存账户、额度、购买和必要运营记录。工作室政策未确定供应商留存规则及删除时点。若供应商条款不符合要求，请勿上传敏感内容。

适合希望在一个托管工作流中使用文生图、布局引导和多种模型的创作者。不适合要求自托管推理、保证输出保真度、供应商独立留存或账户级成本保证的团队。可与 OpenMOSS MOSS-Image 比较本地开放权重控制，也可与其他托管图像工作室比较编辑流程、模型选择、credits 成本和数据路由。现有 OpenMOSS 模型条目保持独立；本选择不创建 Task Fit 或 Task Page。

tw.title: MossImage：獨立託管式影像創作工作室
tw.summary: MossImage 是獨立的瀏覽器影像工作室，提供 MOSS-Image 生成、JSON 版面控制及其他影像模型。公開方案採 credits 計費；本站未測試帳戶權益或目前可用性。
tw.detail:

適合希望在單一託管流程中使用文字生圖、版面引導與多種模型的創作者。不適合要求自行託管推論、保證輸出保真度、供應商獨立保存或帳戶級成本保證的團隊。可與 OpenMOSS MOSS-Image 比較本機開放權重控制，也可與其他託管影像工作室比較編輯流程、模型選擇、credits 成本與資料路由。既有 OpenMOSS 模型項目維持獨立；本選擇不建立 Task Fit 或 Task Page。
